title_zh: 面向多智能体计算机使用的主干-分支协调
one_line: Manager decomposes tasks into a VM-state spine plus disposable parallel branches; Odysseys success up 6-16.5 points over MACU at lower cost, three runs.
one_line_zh: 主干保留VM状态、分支并行收集信息，Odysseys成功率高于MACU且更省钱。

online_eval.quote: Experiments show that on 200 long-horizon tasks from Odysseys and across three CUA backbones, Spine-Branch improves success rate over the baseline system by 6.0% to 16.5%

variance.quote: The standard variance are shown for three evaluation runs.

strong_baselines.quote: We compare three coordination strategies under identical backbones.

budget_matched.quote: For Single-Agent, the step budget is 100 , while each CUA in the multi-agent methods is given 60 .

cost_reported.quote: while cutting per-task financial costs by 34\% to 70\% across all backbones

component_ablation.quote: As shown in Table 2 , removing either spine or branches degrades performance , confirming that the two mechanisms are complementary.

validator_check.quote: Each run is scored by a rubric judge, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, which reads the final trajectory (up to 200 screenshots) and judges all of a task’s rubrics in one pass.

evidence_level.quote: Across three CUA backbones spanning different capability levels, Spine-Branch consistently outperforms the baseline system, improving success rate by 6.0% to 16.5% while reducing per-task financial cost by 34% to 70%.

S1.quote: In the branch-only variant, all workers operate in fresh VMs and communicate exclusively through aritfacts. In the spine-only variant, all workers execute along a single VM lineage without parallel branches.

S5.quote: Across three CUA backbones spanning different capability levels, Spine-Branch consistently outperforms the baseline system

title_zh: CONTRAMEM：从多模型对比轨迹中学习自演化程序性记忆
one_line: Training-free procedural memory distilled from contrasting multi-model trajectories into curated cards; GAIA2/ARE held-out success 26.2%->55.3%, AppWorld gains.
one_line_zh: 对比多模型轨迹提炼函数卡与技能卡，GAIA2留出成功率26.2%升至55.3%。

online_eval.quote: Our primary metric is task success rate (the fraction of tasks passing the environment verifier)

held_out_env.quote: across five abilities (Execution, Search, Ambiguity, Adaptability, Time), with 40 reference and 40 held-out tasks per ability.

strong_baselines.quote: To compare against published agent-memory baselines, we evaluate offline Agent Workflow Memory (AWM) ( Wang et al. 2024 ) , ACE ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , and raw trajectory retrieval on GPT-5.5

budget_matched.quote: Under a matched trajectory budget, heterogeneous multi-model trajectories yield stronger memory than self- or same-model multi-rollout memory

cost_reported.quote: Across all five abilities, ContraMem reduces the macro-average trajectory length from 41.1 to 35.5 agent events per task

component_ablation.quote: We isolate the Curator against an append-only variant committing every Reflector delta as Add , with identical deltas and retrieval.

evidence_level.quote: On held-out GAIA2/ARE computer-use tasks, CONTRAMEM more than doubles the success rate across the three source-model targets (26.2% to 55.3%)

S1.quote: The same three agents serve as sources, each attempting every training-split task once; the same-task triples are contrasted exactly as on GAIA2.

S2.quote: distills them, rather than the raw traces, into Function Cards (app-level tool contracts) and Skill Cards (task-level decision rules)

S5.quote: Table 1 shows that ContraMem more than doubles held-out success on tasks unseen during construction, raising the source-target macro from 26.2% to 55.3%

F3.quote: with 40 reference and 40 held-out tasks per ability

AP5.quote: Given one or more trajectories for a reference task, ContraMem extracts outcome-relevant distinctions along four axes—correctness, efficiency, recovery, and recurring failure

title_zh: CausalCache：面向长程GUI智能体的条件式高保真恢复
one_line: Text history plus a learned selector restoring which past screenshots fill a fixed image budget; desktop-trained, zero-shot MobileWorld 30.2%->36.8%.
one_line_zh: 学习选择哪些历史截图占用固定预算，桌面训练零样本移动端提升6.6点。

online_eval.quote: Zero-shot on $117$ MobileWorld tasks, CausalCache improves over Recent-$4$ from $30.2\%$ to $36.8\%$ .

held_out_env.quote: No mobile benchmark data touches training or selection.

variance.quote: MobileWorld: zero-shot means over three runs for all multi-run arms

strong_baselines.quote: Fidelity-allocation baselines are Recent- B , Random, OCR/RGB similarity, and the learned budget-aware restoration selector (exact- B , recent fallback); a beam oracle over the candidate pool bounds headroom.

budget_matched.quote: Every method receives the same summaries and the same active image budget.

cost_reported.quote: CausalCache adds a median of eight policy calls per task, about 7\% of median end-to-end task time.

component_ablation.quote: Running the same selector on the fully frozen policy retains most of the margin ( 33.9\% ), and re-teaching it from frozen-policy-scored labels retains less ( 33.3\% )

evidence_level.quote: The adapter and selector are trained with matched-budget interventions on desktop trajectories and evaluated zero-shot on mobile.

S2.quote: Under a budget of B high-fidelity history images, Recent- B promotes the latest B events. CausalCache reallocates the same B promotions over the complete trace, with recent events as the default

title_zh: GSAR：面向移动GUI智能体的目标状态锚点奖励与自演化数据合成
one_line: VLM outcome reward anchored on annotated goal-state screenshots plus self-evolving task synthesis; >90% offline verification accuracy, AndroidWorld 26.7%->30.2%.
one_line_zh: 以锚定目标状态截图辅助VLM判奖励，离线验证超90%，在线RL有提升。

online_eval.quote: Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and performs closest to rule-based methods.

held_out_env.quote: We select a subset of 42 tasks as the training set, while evaluation is conducted on the full benchmark.

strong_baselines.quote: we compare our method with three representative model-based approaches for reward verification from prior work: DigiRL 1 , DistRL 28 , and StepCritic 12 .

cost_reported.quote: As shown in Table 5 , GSAR therefore achieves lower overall rollout latency than the rule-based baseline.

component_ablation.quote: We perform ablation experiments on offline verification to assess the contribution of each component.

validator_check.quote: we further construct an evaluation set from execution traces in AndroidWorld 22 . Specifically, we collect more than 300 trajectories containing both positive and negative examples, and report Accuracy and F1 score.

evidence_level.quote: GSAR increases the performance to 30.2% (+3.5%), while rule-based rewards achieve 32.8% (+6.1%) due to their near-noiseless verification signals.

S1.quote: Verification using GSAR shows similar trends to human evaluation, with some metrics closely matching human judgments.

S2.quote: We obtain goal states from the self-evolving data synthesis stage by extracting the final screenshot of successful trajectories.

F1.quote: For tasks whose completion cannot be fully expressed visually (e.g., deleting certain items), it is difficult for the model to annotate reasonable task-relevant elements

AP4.quote: During online training, these references are used to provide accurate and semantically grounded reward signals.

AP5.quote: The model is fine-tuned on data collected from 20 AndroidWorld apps and further scaled using data from 40 selected open-source apps.

AP7.quote: We report Type Match (TM) and Exact Match (EM) as the primary evaluation metrics.

AP8.quote: we construct a benchmark consisting of 86 queries with their corresponding initial environment snapshots and annotated reference goal states. Half of the queries are used as the training split.

title_zh: 基于动作诱发视觉差异的桌面GUI智能体反思
one_line: Reflector decouples SoM-marked visual-diff evidence from outcome verification; three-run OSWorld-Verified +5.94 and WindowsAgentArena +4.95 points across four backbones.
one_line_zh: 反思器先提取差异证据再判定结果，OSWorld与WAA三次平均提升约5点。

online_eval.quote: Experiments on OSWorld-Verified and WindowsAgentArena demonstrate that EFR improves reflector accuracy by 7.11%, yielding average end-to-end task success gains of 5.94% and 4.95% on the two benchmarks, respectively.

variance.quote: We repeat each main POR and POR-EFR experiment three times and report the mean success rate across 3 runs in Tables 1 and 2 .

strong_baselines.quote: We adopt the conventional POR framework as our baseline, adhering to the implementation established in Mobile-Agent-v3 [ 36 ] .

budget_matched.quote: We set the maximum number of steps to 50 for GUI-specialized and proprietary models, while open-source general-purpose models are restricted to a maximum of 15 steps.

cost_reported.quote: Averaged over the four backbone models, POR-EFR increases per-task latency by 15.8% and token usage by 14.9% on OSWorld-Verified, and by 13.3% and 17.9% on WindowsAgentArena, respectively.

component_ablation.quote: Ablating the page difference identification module, whereby the reflector evaluates success directly after receiving the marked screenshots results in a significant 6.70% decrease in the success rate.

validator_check.quote: we manually annotated the correctness of the reflector’s judgments for each step within the GUI-Owl-32B trajectories on the OSWorld-Verified benchmark.

evidence_level.quote: On OSWorld-Verified, Table 1 shows that replacing the standard reflector in POR with EFR consistently improves the mean overall success rate across all four backbones, with an average gain of 5.94%.

S4.quote: Within the POR loop, EFR replaces the conventional reflector: after the planner generates a plan and the operator executes the corresponding action, EFR evaluates whether the action produced correct result and feeds the reflection result back into the next planning step.

AP4.quote: Finally, after execution, the Reflector compares the pre-action screenshot S_{t}^{pre} with the post-action screenshot S_{t}^{post} to assess the outcome of the action A_{t} and produce the reflection R_{t}

title_zh: 从盲目编辑到验证修复：构建可信的用户端LLM网页无障碍智能体
one_line: Local-LLM browser extension injecting CSS for accessibility; blind edits help and harm equally, so an audit-inject-verify loop accepts only violation-reducing edits.
one_line_zh: 本地小模型注入无障碍CSS盲改利弊相当，提出仅接受改进的验证循环。

online_eval.quote: For each model and website, the evaluator loaded the site, captured a before screenshot, triggered the agent, and captured an after screenshot once the generated CSS was injected.

budget_matched.quote: All models received identical prompts and the identical 10,000-token budget, so model identity is the only manipulated variable

validator_check.quote: In a real browser the instrument detects 57 of 57 seeded violations with no false positives and rejects 126 of 126 adversarially harmful candidates.

code.quote: All code, prompts, benchmark materials, aggregate data, and validation logs are released.

S4.quote: a verified repair instrument pairing a trilingual seeded-violation benchmark with an audit-inject-verify loop that accepts a change only if violations strictly decrease, so regression on the automated checks is impossible by construction.

AP8.quote: We evaluated six open-weight models, 7B to 14B parameters across four vendors, on twenty live websites

title_zh: LocalLSTC：面向本地部署GUI智能体的长短期控制架构
one_line: Training-free loop keeping a persistent subgoal/evidence/feedback state with step abstraction and final verification; Qwen3.8-27B reaches 73.7% OSWorld, 68.5% WindowsAgentArena.
one_line_zh: 免训练维护持久子目标与证据状态，本地27B模型OSWorld达73.7%。

online_eval.quote: With Qwen3.8-27B, LocalLSTC reaches 73.7\% SR-100 on OSWorld and 68.5\% on WindowsAgentArena, achieving the strongest local OSWorld result and a new state of the art on WindowsAgentArena.

variance.quote: Main benchmark results are averaged over two independent runs with the same parameter settings. Unless otherwise stated, other experiments use a single run.

strong_baselines.quote: Under the same Qwen3.5-9B backbone, LocalLSTC reaches 47.6% SR-100, 12.4 points above the four-framework average.

budget_matched.quote: SR-100, SR-50, and SR-15 impose maximum budgets of 100, 50, and 15 steps.

cost_reported.quote: Removing Step Abstraction increases token use from 252.2k to 276.2k, planner steps from 26.1 to 31.9, and runtime from 390.4 to 428.7 seconds

component_ablation.quote: Removing L2S lowers SR-100 from 47.6% to 36.4%, while removing S2L lowers it to 41.5%

validator_check.quote: To validate the reliability of the GPT annotations, we stratify OSWorld tasks by domain and randomly sample 37 tasks, yielding 185 trajectories across the five methods.

code.quote: Code is released through an anonymous repository to support reproducibility.

evidence_level.quote: On WindowsAgentArena, the same configuration reaches 68.5\pm 1.6\% SR-100, 67.9\pm 0.6\% SR-50, and 57.5\pm 4.9\% SR-15, establishing a new state of the art at all three step budgets.

S1.quote: Removing L2S lowers SR-100 from 47.6% to 36.4%, while removing S2L lowers it to 41.5%, showing that performance degrades when either grouped mechanism is removed under the same Qwen3.5-9B backbone.

S4.quote: Step Abstraction (SA) evaluates the observed execution outcome against the intended effect of the current commitment.

F1.quote: Step Abstraction, Context Refinement, and Final Verification use the planner backbone under dedicated prompts (Appendix B ), while state assignment and routing are deterministic runtime operations.

AP4.quote: The finish route invokes Final Verification, which evaluates task completion against accumulated visual, textual, and software API evidence (Appendix A.6 ).

AP8.quote: Main benchmark results are averaged over two independent runs with the same parameter settings.

title_zh: ASIL：以结构化状态与语义动作取代截图加点击
one_line: Agent-software layer exposing structured JSON state and semantic code actions across 15 apps; ~81% vs 6.6-26.6% GUI success, SFT/RL gains for small models.
one_line_zh: 用结构化状态与语义动作替代截图点击，成功率约81%远超GUI控制。

online_eval.quote: The evaluator checks final software state rather than surface-level action histories.

held_out_env.quote: a low-overlap training task pool generated separately from the evaluation benchmark

strong_baselines.quote: Bottom: matched native-interface baselines, run on identical tasks with the same evaluator, model, 15-step budget, and no success hint.

budget_matched.quote: the repaired GUI rows use a 50-step native-computer-use budget, with one additional row truncating the same sonnet4.6 trajectories at 15 actions.

cost_reported.quote: the final RL runs use 320 training tasks and 80 validation tasks with 4 A800 GPUs for 2B and 8 A800 GPUs for 9B.

component_ablation.quote: A GIMP visual-supplement ablation (44 tasks, no hint, 50 steps) gives 44.1 mean for ASIL-only and 43.7 with per-step screenshots

validator_check.quote: A fail-closed raw validator that does not call the ASIL observation builder agrees with the official evaluator on 60/60 balanced final states.

code.quote: We mitigate these risks by releasing task definitions, validators, adapter code, training data, and failure summaries

evidence_level.quote: GPT-5.4 reaches 81.6 under ASIL versus 6.6 under GUI; sonnet4.6 reaches 81.2 versus 26.6, and 17.9 when the same GUI trajectories are restricted to ASIL’s 15-step budget.

S5.quote: For each application, we first identify the deepest feasible access path: the interface that exposes stable state and semantic operations closest to the software’s real transition system while remaining practical to run and evaluate.

F5.quote: some target conditions depend on pixel-level image semantics that the current semantic action vocabulary does not fully cover.

F6.quote: Functions available only through opaque software with no parseable file, scripting, structured-command, or service surface remain out of scope.

AP5.quote: a low-overlap training task pool generated separately from the evaluation benchmark (a learnable 320/80 RL subset is drawn from a final 512/128 v3 pool covering all 15 domains)

title_zh: WM-R1：用强化学习训练GUI智能体推理并利用世界模型
one_line: GRPO trains mobile agents entirely inside a frozen Code2World world model with in-thought simulation calls; AndroidWorld 7B 39.8 vs UI-R1 30.8.
one_line_zh: 完全在世界模型中用GRPO训练手机智能体，AndroidWorld达39.8。

online_eval.quote: At 7B scale, WM-R1-7B reaches 39.8 on AndroidWorld, outperforming UI-R1-7B ( Lu et al. 2025c ) (30.8) by +9.0 points and UI-TARS 1.5-7B (34.2) by +5.6 points.

held_out_env.quote: AndroidControl and GUI-Odyssey serve as ID benchmarks while AndroidWorld and ScreenSpot-Pro/V2 are OOD.

strong_baselines.quote: WM-R1-3B (29.5) substantially outperforms all 3B-scale baselines including UI-R1-3B ( Lu et al. 2025c ) (18.6) and GUI-R1-3B ( Luo et al. 2025b ) (17.4).

budget_matched.quote: AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al. 2023 ) , testing multi-step mobile device control with a maximum execution length of 15

cost_reported.quote: For efficient training, we curate a high-quality dataset of 2000 challenging tasks.

component_ablation.quote: We evaluate three variants of WM-R1, each removing a single design choice from the full system.

validator_check.quote: We use LLM-as-a-judge to compare the final trajectory against the reference solution.

evidence_level.quote: AndroidControl and GUI-Odyssey serve as ID benchmarks while AndroidWorld and ScreenSpot-Pro/V2 are OOD. WM-R1 achieves an average OOD improvement of +16.0 relative to ZS baseline

F1.quote: Crucially, WM-R1 eliminates the need for real-environment interaction

F2.quote: Repeat. Steps 1–3 continue until the agent produces a terminal action or the trajectory reaches the maximum length

AP1.quote: Each training trajectory is generated through an iterative loop between the policy model and the world model.

AP2.quote: we propose WM-R1, the first reinforcement learning framework that trains mobile GUI agents entirely within a simulated environment, namely world models.

AP4.quote: We use LLM-as-a-judge to compare the final trajectory against the reference solution. The reward is binary

AP9.quote: We evaluate three variants of WM-R1, each removing a single design choice from the full system.

title_zh: Iron：增强通用虚拟智能体的意图对齐与回顾式对偶学习框架
one_line: Self-training with intent-action cycle-consistency rewards in MCTS and hindsight relabelling of failed trajectories; gains on OSWorld, AndroidWorld and unseen VisualWebArena.
one_line_zh: 循环一致性奖励引导MCTS并回顾重标注失败轨迹，跨平台自训练提升。

online_eval.quote: On the stronger Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, Iron-30k achieves 41.96% on OSWorld and 39.15% on AndroidWorld, surpassing the Full model with fewer training samples.

held_out_env.quote: The Iron framework shows robust transferability to the unseen VisualWebArena benchmark.

strong_baselines.quote: For controlled comparisons, variants within each backbone share the initialization, evaluation protocol, and IL data scale. Full uses 3\times IL data for supervised fine-tuning as a data-scaling baseline

cost_reported.quote: we progressively refined the agent through iterative training, using 30k high-quality data through gradual exploration

component_ablation.quote: Removing Hindsight Reproduction results in further performance drops, highlighting its importance in leveraging unsuccessful trajectories for improving exploration diversity.

validator_check.quote: Across 150 samples per iteration, SCC Match accuracy increases from 74.5% at 5k steps to 92.5% at 30k steps, while agreement with GPT-5.4 rises from Cohen’s \kappa=0.48 to 0.82 .

evidence_level.quote: Iron delivers superior cross-platform results, consistently outperforming the Step-DPO variant and the baseline trained with triple the SFT data.

S3.quote: we designed five key metrics ( Repeatability, Logicality, Ineffectiveness, Exploratory, Invalidity ) to filter useless converted trajectories.
